q: The cost of a countable standard equivalence relation E on (X,μ) is defined (Levitt, Gaboriau) as:
opts: inf{μ(Φ) : Φ generates E} = inf over graphings (measurable generating subsets of E) of their measure
The rank of the associated von Neumann algebra
exp: Cost of E: C(E) = inf{μ(graphing)} over all graphings (Borel subsets of E\ diagonal that generate E). For a free action of Γ, C(E_Γ) = β₁^{(2)}(Γ) − χ(Γ) for many groups (Gaboriau's formula connecting cost to l²-Betti numbers).
